newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's three crude ports shut due to winds.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's three crude ports shut due to winds.

text.p: Mexico's three crude shipping ports were closed Monday as a cold front blew winds of up to 50 kilometers per hour along the Gulf of Mexico, port capitains said.
Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) crude port Cayo Arcas in Campeche state shut at 0830 local/1430 GMT Monday, officials at the port said.
Dos Bocas in Tabasco state closed Sunday at 0700/1300, while Pajaritos in Veracruz state shut Sunday at 1110/1710, according to port officials there.
Cayo Arcas ships an average 600,000 barrels per day (bpd) of crude, while Pajaritos exports 400,000 bpd and Dos Bocas ships about 300,000 bpd, according to state-owned oil and gas monopoly Pemex.
